title: Compliance Notify Orchestrator: unified audit, retention and residency event API
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a unified Compliance Notify Orchestrator (CNO) API that emits structured events and drives actions for data residency changes, retention policy enforcement, and audit evidence exports. This ticket covers API surface, orchestration rules, retry/dedup semantics, signing/auth for downstream receivers, and a minimal SDK for partners. Primary goals: 1) provide a single subscription endpoint for downstream compliance systems; 2) ensure tamper-evident payloads and delivery guarantees aligned with enterprise SLAs; 3) support action-oriented messages (e.g., 'schedule-delete', 'move-region', 'export-evidence') so receivers can trigger automated workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Public API spec published in Confluence with example payloads for audit, retention, and residency events
Webhook endpoints support HMAC signing and JWT bearer authentication; verification documented
Exactly-once semantics within a 5 minute window (dedup by event_id + source_id); retries with exponential backoff up to 72 hours for transient errors

Retention action messages include a stable schema with reason, selector (workspace_id, dataset, model_version), and execution ETA; supported actions: schedule-delete, extend-retention, export-evidence
Residency change events provide pre-commit notification and post-commit confirmation with region migration logs attached
Integration tests exercising end-to-end delivery to a mock receiver and failure modes (auth failure, 5xx backoff, duplicate delivery) are green
Documentation and SDK examples (Node + Python) included in the repo and linked from Console webhooks UI
tasks: Design event schema with versioning strategy and MIGRATION guide
Implement emitter with dedup window and persistent queue (Kafka topic + tombstone index)
Add HMAC signing and rotateable keys; integrate with KMS for signing key storage
Implement receiver simulator service for integration tests
Add webhooks UI changes in Console to manage subscriptions, secret rotations, and delivery logs
Create Node/Python SDK helpers for signature verification and event parsing
Run security review and threat model for payload leakage and replay attacks
